capabilities: Add space leader key sequences for editor and other views
Provide neo-tree-style keyboard control of the file explorer
Sync vim yanks, deletes and pastes with the system clipboard
Remap select-all, copy, cut and paste keys in vim mode
Show which-key-style popups for pending key sequences
extras: Desktop only; editor leader keys require Obsidian's built-in vim mode to be enabled. Not yet in the community plugin directory, so it must be installed manually. Uses undocumented internals for the file explorer and vim register syncing, which may break on Obsidian updates.
intentEvidence: neo-tree-style keys for Obsidian's built-in file explorer in the sidebar
problem: Obsidian's vim mode has no leader keys, and the built-in file explorer cannot be driven from the keyboard like a Neovim file tree.

relations.evidence: Find files (Omnisearch if installed, otherwise the quick switcher)
space g g | Git view (Obsidian Git)
